text:
Maddie: Quick heads-up, ran a 1hr canary for the adjusted prober + adaptive microbatch logic. p95 stable but p99 has short spikes during bursty traffic. infra-bot: canary summary: 2025-03-02 14:00-15:00 UTC, total reqs 41.8k, avg qps 11.6, p95=125ms, p99=760ms (spike windows ~2x bursts), scale events=6, cold_starts=4.

Leo: any traces showing kernel swap happening at the same time as KV misses? I suspect the kernel selector flips variant mid-burst and we pay both a kernel handshake + KV fetch.

Maddie: captured a couple traces. example snippet:
```
[trace]
seq=0..30 request=256 tokens
kernel_switch: attn_fp16->quant8  (30ms handshake)
kv_lookup: miss -> remote_fetch (140ms)
microbatch_sync: stall (90ms)
response_end -> p99=980ms
```

Sam: yikes. Two orthogonal systems colliding. Prober upsamples batch size based on a single noisy sample so kernel_swap_count spikes, and KV prewarm is keyed by instance id, not kernel variant, so new kernel variants lack warmed KV.

Tasha: proposals: 1) index KV prewarm by (model, kv_version, kernel_variant) so the prewarm follows the kernel choice. 2) add prober hysteresis: require N consistent samples before changing batch_size (N=3 default). 3) transient warm-routing: newly scaled instances get only warm-routing traffic for first T seconds.

Devon: +1. Also add a budget guard so warm-routing doesn't spawn unlimited warm instances for a noisy tenant. Ops wants a hard cap.

Maddie: ran a small canary with hysteresis=3 and kv_prewarm per kernel_variant. results: same burst load, p99 dropped median from 760ms -> ~270ms, p95 unchanged. cold_start count reduced to 1. throughput impact negligible.

Leo: nice. can you paste the prober/kv YAML used on the canary?

Maddie: pasted below: 
```
prober:
  sample_interval_ms: 250
  hysteresis_samples: 3
  up_threshold: 0.6
kv_prewarm:
  enabled: true
  index_by: [model, kv_version, kernel_variant]
  warm_window_s: 15
routing:
  warm_routing_duration_s: 12
  warm_budget_per_tenant: 2
```

Sam: next steps: 24h A/B at 20% traffic, track per-tenant p99, kernel_swap_count/min, kv_fetch_latency p95/p99, and cold_start rate. Rollout criteria: >=40% p99 reduction OR <5% throughput regression.

Tasha: I'll add dashboards and alerts. Suggested alerts: kernel_swap_count > 4/min, kv_fetch_latency_p95 > 60ms, warm_budget_exhausted.

Devon: ops playbook: if rollout pushes GPU usage > baseline+10% for >10min, auto-fallback to selector=conservative and kill new warm routing. Also log affected tenants.

Maddie: I'll open an RFC with canary numbers + config diff and schedule the A/B. filing RFC now. infra-bot: RFC created rfc/1712-kv-per-kernel-warm, link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/1712-kv-per-kernel-warm

Leo: ack, will help wire the kernel_swap metric emitter.

Sam: I'll run the experiment and own rollout decision. Posting experiment checklist in the RFC.

Tasha: dashboard PR incoming.

Devon: noted on budget guard. One extra ask: emit warm_instance_count per tenant so we can track cost.

Maddie: thanks everyone. will post A/B results here when complete. :thumbsup:
